summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to retain Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP as counsel for its Form SF-3 registration statement in connection with asset-backed securitization transactions. The filing discloses the issuance of $380.57M Class A-1 notes and $511.005M Class A-2 notes by Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-B Owner Trust. No special situation event is present; this is a routine legal opinion and shelf registration update. No deal terms, tender offer, acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. The filing is a standard current report for an ABS issuer.
